tasks.title: Implement configured high-FPS video and bounded in-page PCM media streaming
constraints: Preserve ScreencastProducer::new and ViewerCreditController::new 100 ms defaults; configure production through the new builders.
No Runtime.enable or added CDP commands in apply_stealth_and_focus/apply_stealth_to_session; preserve exact existing setup order.
Keep BHJF, native ACK, viewer credits, auth/origin/ticket/profile fencing, sandbox and input control limits unchanged.
Audio capture/drain is bounded, current-run/cancellation fenced, demand-driven and never blocks the video drain on a page RPC.
Only exact listed files are writable; escalate required changes outside ownership. Coordinator owns integrated verification and maintained documentation.
acceptance: Default 24 FPS/JPEG 75 and nondefault validated budgets reach screencast, fallback screenshot, producer governor and both viewer delivery paths; pending flush is 15 ms.
Requested media capability/device/permission patches and exact autoplay flag are installed without security-flag broadening or setup-sequence regression.
Ordinary page media and WebAudio produce bounded 24 kHz mono PCM16LE audioChunk text envelopes with server-owned identity and viewer-specific subscription fencing alongside unchanged binary video.
No audio history survives zero demand, run restart, navigation or reset; lagged/invalid audio is dropped without consuming video credits or defeating auth cancellation.
Automated policy/wire/lifecycle regressions exist in allowed files; real capture, embedded frames and playback are qualified by coordinator, not inferred from script text.
verification: Coordinator runs cargo check --manifest-path server/Cargo.toml and focused config/producer/protocol unit tests after implementation; record commands/exits and preserve 100 ms constructor assertions.

Coordinator runs cargo test --manifest-path server/Cargo.toml --test browser_host_process --test browser_host_media --test browser_host_screencast; existing screencast integration coverage remains unmodified unless separately authorized.

Exercise real Chromium ordinary media, WebAudio, embedded frames, dynamic sources, navigation, demand stop/restart, mixed text/binary delivery and live-auth/reset cancellation; record observed PCM format, bounded queues and actual failures without credentials or raw audio logs.

tasks.title: Integrate privacy-fenced gapless PCM playback and BrowserApp mute controls
constraints: Consume phase 01's exact authenticated media text contract; preserve BHJF/video credits and captured owner/socket/subscription authority.
New pcm-player.ts must stay under 200 lines; no WebRTC/AEC, mic capture, dependency, persistence or new global store.

Immediately silence and flush scheduled/pending audio on user mute, Cognito, LockScreen, profile reset fence, !isEffectiveVisible, authority retirement and disposal; late async completions cannot resume old sound.
Keep runtime player/controller root-owned across OS reparenting; BrowserApp owns only viewer-local mute intent and toolbar/gesture interaction.
Only listed files are writable; coordinator owns integrated verification, review, maintained docs and finalization.
acceptance: Valid current-subscription 24 kHz mono PCM16 audioChunk text messages play gaplessly in BrowserApp while binary video behavior remains unchanged; invalid or stale audio is ignored safely.
The toolbar exposes data-testid browser-audio-toggle-btn, accessible Mute/Unmute action and pressed state, per-viewer ephemeral mute, no control-lease requirement and gesture-based autoplay recovery.
All suppression and retirement paths synchronously zero gain, stop sources, clear pending PCM and fence deferred resume; restoring visibility or unmuting cannot replay suppressed audio.
The dependency-free player is under 200 lines, bounded to 500 ms pending/scheduled audio, uses exact sample duration scheduling and releases sources/context on teardown.
Tests cover mixed media parsing, PCM scheduling, malformed/bounded input, late promise/socket callbacks, all privacy gates, independent viewers and keep-alive reparenting.
verification: Coordinator runs pnpm --filter @dam-hopper/ui exec vitest run src/browser-host/pcm-player.test.ts src/browser-host/stream-controller.test.ts src/os/BrowserStreamKeepAliveHost.test.tsx src/os/apps/BrowserApp.test.tsx, then pnpm --filter @dam-hopper/ui build; record exact results.

Confirm pcm-player.ts has fewer than 200 physical lines; test scheduled start times and synchronous source-stop/gain-zero behavior with controlled AudioContext boundary doubles, including unresolved resume promises.

With real host Chromium and output browser, exercise ordinary video/audio and WebAudio playback, adjacent chunks, mute/unmute, Cognito, LockScreen, reset, hide/minimize/desktop switch, navigation, reconnect, owner change and two viewers; record audible behavior, bounded latency and actual autoplay restrictions separately from unit results.
